sections.thesis: The Fed is set to press ahead with another rate increase in December despite weeks of equity turmoil; core PCE inflation accelerated from 3.1 to 3.3 per cent in October.

sentences.text: The Fed is set to press ahead with another rate increase in December despite weeks of equity turmoil; core PCE inflation accelerated from 3.1 to 3.3 per cent in October.
Futures implied a 99% chance of a 25 basis point hike, with the two-year Treasury yield up 3bp to 4.6705% and the ten-year up 4bp to 4.8918%.

sections.thesis: The dollar headed for a third monthly gain on safe-haven demand and bets on Fed hikes, while the euro held flat at $1.0964 after news that Pablo Hernández de Cos will become ECB president.

The yen softened after Tokyo core inflation of 2.9% missed the 3.0% forecast, with USD/JPY near 159.35 and Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama warning against "one-sided, rapid" moves.

sections.thesis: Asian markets were mostly higher, tracking US stock futures as AI sentiment stabilized with US markets closed for Thanksgiving: E-mini Nasdaq futures rose 1.3%, the Kospi 1.65% and the Nikkei 0.7%.

sections.thesis: Oil headed for its first weekly gain in November as renewed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and shipping near Hormuz raised supply concerns, including a Houthi strike on the Jazan refinery.
